mainHtml:
Black Friday - Top 5 black cars on Bidders Highway!

Featured cars
This week we're highlighting the best black cars sold at Bidders Highway. Black Friday is in full swing with special offers, shopping and bargain prices. But in the midst of the pre-Christmas buying frenzy, we're taking a slightly different approach this Friday and using the theme to highlight the absolute coolest black cars sold on our marketplace.
Tomas JönssonNovember 29, 2024 13:46

When it comes to black cars, there are often many opinions, it can be anything from "they're too hard to keep clean" to "there's nothing as nice as a freshly polished black car". Then we have those who fully embrace the dark side and drive a car that is completely "blacked out". Black paint, black rims, black tinted lights and windows tinted with 0% see through.

Below we present, in no particular order, our "Top 5 black cars sold". All with one thing in common - They are all black as night.

1965 Superformance Cobra

First up: A genuine Superformance Cobra MK III, built under full license from none other than Carroll Shelby Licensing Inc. Equipped with a 351 Windsor stroked to a massive 426cui and built by Southern Automotive in Georgia. This Cobra is nothing short of an American icon in automotive circles!  

Sold for 104.050 EUR. THE AUCTION


1989 Honda Civic CRX

This is a Swedish-sold Honda CRX from 1989 with the same owner since the car was new! This completely untouched JDM classic has only driven an incredible 5082km since new. The seller of this unique Honda has always had a great love for the CRX models and the family has earned the epithet "CRX Family". A 35-year-old Japanese classic that hasn't even had its first service filled in the service book.  

Sold for 21.050 EUR. THE AUCTION


1956 Chevrolet 3100/3200 NAPCO Powr-Pak 4x4

Näst på tur hittar vi denna USA-importerade Chevrolet 3100/3200 NAPCO Powr-Pak 4x4 från 1956. NAPCO (Northwestern Auto Parts Company) är ett Next up, we find this US-imported Chevrolet 3100/3200 NAPCO Powr-Pak 4x4 from 1956. NAPCO (Northwestern Auto Parts Company) is an American company that produced 4-wheel drive for American car manufacturers. After World War II, the company focused on making conversion kits for rear-wheel drive pickups. Equipped with 5.7-liter V8 with aluminum intake and headers. Shifts are handled by a 4-speed TH700 automatic with engageable low gear. Indisputable coolness factor on this pickup!

Sold for 28.650 EUR. THE AUCTION


2007 Porsche 997 Turbo

On this badass Porsche Turbo, it is "Black on black" that applies, from the paint, to the rims to the interior. The yellow brake calipers, on the other hand, gossip that there are ceramic brakes on this rocket for a car. The Boxer-6 of 3.6L with twin turbo delivers 480hp and 620 nm, with an overboost of 680 nm. Add to that four-wheel drive and you have a very fast car that can be used every day, all year round, without problems. 

Sold for 54.050 EUR. THE AUCTION


1951 Jaguar XK 120

The Jaguar XK120 was the first sports car from Jaguar since 1939 and was highly anticipated, which was evident in the response. The car was a success and even today fine examples are highly sought after on the market and have broken record after record at the auction houses. In addition to the fantastic design, the car took several speed records and was competed with great success in racing. This example left the factory on 21 January 1951 and was sold new by Henleys in London before being imported to Sweden in 1968.

Sold for 54.650 EUR. THE AUCTION
